balls.text: Goes for a length ball that's quite wide. Shashank drags it away to long-on and they only get a single as Punjab Kings finish on 176 for 6
Full down leg, Rawat collects and has a shy at the stumps but misses by a lot as Shashank hurried across for the single. Called wide as well. But it's reviewed, only in vain. The wide call remains
Length ball outside off again, he looks to slap it over cover but can't get the distance on it. Falls short of Kohli in the deep
Short outside off, Shashank slashes at it and gets it over short third for a boundary!
Hammered into the stands! Length ball, pace off, outside off sits up nicely and Shashank just swings it away over midwicket

Alzarri responds with a short ball outside off, but it's too wide. But RCB review the wide call now! Shashank had moved across the stumps, which the third umpire says is "significant". Says the movement of the batter is more than the ball is outside the line and instructs the on-ground umpire to reverse his decision!
Too full, too straight and Shashank flicks it away over square leg! Great start to the over for Punjab Kings
Brar looks to move leg side and steer it past the keeper but is beaten by a 140kph full toss angled across the stumps. Great over from Siraj
Full on leg, clipped away to deep midwicket's left as they hare for two

Short ball does the trick again! Second bouncer of the over, outside off. Jitesh looks to slap it on the off side but it goes high in the air. Anuj Rawat has been excellent with the gloves today and again, he makes no mistake. But wait! They are checking if it hit the Spider-Cam! But no reprieve for Jitesh after a check by the umpire. Seems to not have had any contact with the camera or the wires
Short outside off, Shashank gets a top edge on the pull and it lands in the vacant midwicket area
Just short of long-on! On a length around middle and Jitesh swings at it but doesn't get the connection
Nails the wide yorker, just inside the line. Jitesh enquires with the umpire about a wide, but to no avail. Jitesh has reviewed for a wide. But replay confirms it was just inside the line

Full around middle, Shashank clips it out towards long-on and the fielder sprints in and has a throw at the non-striker's end as the batters went for two. Just misses a direct hit, which would have seen Jitesh back in the hut! Good fielding from the sub Prabhudessai

What a brilliant catch! Take a bow, Anuj Rawat! Dayal directs a bouncer at Curran, who looks to pull but was cramped for room. Ends up gloving it. Rawat sticks his right arm up as he jumps in the air and plucks it out of the air. And that will be all for Sam Curran today. A few boundaries this over, but overall a fantastic spell from Yash Dayal. And he has another delivery to go!
That's another full toss from Dayal on the stumps and Curran whips it off his pads in front of square leg. he picks up a boundary
Slower bouncer outside off but it veers away as Curran leaves it. Umpire deems it to be wide
Nails the wide yorker this time! Curran jams his bat down but can't connect
That's a full toss, quite high, outside off. Curran clubs it down the ground for four past mid-off. Not given a no-ball though
Goes for the wide yorker but it's wide of the tram-lines and Dayal will have to bowl that again
Starts with a low full toss around off, Jitesh drive it but can't beat wide mid-off
Length ball angled across Jitesh who can only help it along to deep backward square
Back of length around leg, nudged away through square leg. This was bowled at close to 145kph
Very full on middle and off at 140kph, whipped away to wide long-on
Bouncer outside off at 144kph. Jitesh looks to cut but can't get bat on ball
Jitesh gets lucky! He was totally outfoxed by a slower ball, full around off. Looked to swing it away but only gets an inside edge that dribbles past the leg stump and to the fine leg boundary
On a length outside off at 142kph, pushed out to cover
Goes for the yorker around off and Curran digs it back out to Siraj, who gives Curran a bit of a stare down
Another bouncer angled across Curran, this time at 135kph, and he looks to pull but can't get bat on it
Full on middle, whipped away to deep midwicket
Siraj bangs in a slower bouncer at 126kph around leg and going across Curran who think about a ramp but in the end, doesn't try it. The ball deflects off Rawat's foot though and they scamper a bye
On a length on middle and off, slapped away to sweeper cover
Length ball going across Curran who slaps it away to wide long-off running in from the boundary
Low full toss on middle, driven wide of long-off
Two in a row! This is a length ball on leg, not a half-tracker, but Jitesh waits on it and muscles it over deep square leg
What a shot from Jitesh Sharma! This is full outside off, Jitesh skips out of the track and hammers it down the ground
Bowls it on a length outside off, spinning away, and cut to cover
Another short one outside off, this time punched to Kohli's left at sweeper cover
A bit of a short one angled across Curran who cuts it hard but Kohli at sweeper cover runs across to his right and stops the boundary
Full outside off and angling into the stumps, blocked back to the bowler
Back of length delivery outside off and Curran just fends it through the vacant midwicket area for a quick single
Top-edges the pull as Green goes short but he gets it between deep backward square and deep midwicket. Lucky runs, but Punjab Kings will take 'em as they come
Angles a length ball in from outside off, Curran clips it out and it beats the wide mid-on running to his left but they only get two
Full outside off, driven out square on the off side for a single
Green gets away as he strays down leg. Curran can only flick it away gently to long leg
Length ball around off, Curran works it away to long-on
Tossed up full, Jitesh drives it out wide of long-off
Angles in a length ball that Jitesh tucks to midwicket
On a length outside off, Curran tucks it out to deep midwicket
Tossed up full outside off, Jitesh eases it out to long-on

Two wickets in two balls! Dhawan holes out to long-off and RCB players are absolutely pumped! This is tossed up outside off and spinning away from Dhawan as he looks to go inside out. Miscues it to Kohli down the ground who takes a simple catch. That's the set batter gone

Joseph gets the big wicket of Livingstone! Joseph bowls it short and wide and Livingstone looks to cut it away. Gets a thick edge through to the keeper. That's a big breakthrough delivered by one of their marquee signings!
Length ball outside off at 143kph angles in and Dhawan manages to get it away to backward square
Short outside off, pace off this time, Livingstone pulls it away to deep midwicket
Short and very wide and he will have to rebowl that
Bangs it in short outside off at 141kph, Livingstone goes for a big swing and misses
144kph, attempts a yorker but it turns into a low full toss and Livingstone is able to dig it away through midwicket and pick up a brace
Length ball angles in to cramp Dhawan for room. He steers it fine of backward point and they squeeze a quick single

Livingstone is in the groove! Full outside off, Livingstone goes across the stumps, gets down on a knee and deposits over deep midwicket. The fielder was standing a few yards in but it would have barely mattered!
Length ball spins in from outside off, pushed out to cover
Livingstone gives charge to Maxwell and drives it down the ground to long-on for a brace
Pulled away with perfect placement! It's a half-tracker and Livingstone rocks back and hammers it away
Length ball on the pads, tucked square for a single
Full outside off, eased to long-on
Dhawan skips out to turn a full delivery into a full toss and squeezes it out to cover
Dropped slightly short outside off, Livingstone slaps it away to deep cover
Beauty! Full outside off and it spins away to beat Livingstone's forward defence. There's a check for stumping, but he had his foot grounded behind the crease
On a length outside off and spinning away, Livingstone get it out to backward point
Full on middle at 96kph, Dhawan clips it out to deep square leg
On a length outside off, spins in sharply and hits Livingstone on the pad. Impact was well outside off though
Goes for another big shot and perishes! The ball bounces quite sharply from a length as Prabhsimran looks to slog. Gets a top edge high in the air and to Rawat's left and the keeper makes no mistake
In the arch on middle and Prabhsimran swings it away over square leg for a maximum
Length ball darted in on a length. Prabhsimran misses as he looks to swipe
Tossed up full, eased to wide long-on
Starts off with a bit of a drag-down outside off and Dhawan latches on to it with a cut through point. Siraj, patrolling the deep, can't stop it
Full and eased out to sweeper cover
Dhawan let's loose! He skips down the track and finally makes a clean connection. Didn't quite get to the pitch of the ball but gets enough power to heave it over long-on
Swept away fine of deep backward square. This was on a length around middle and leg, Prabhsimran waited for it before hitting it away
Dhawan looks to sweep as Dagar tosses it up outside off but can only get an underedge through midwicket
Prabhsimran gives charge to Dagar as he bowls it full on middle and off but can't connect cleanly as he gets it out to long-on
Darts it in full on middle, Dhawan tucks it out to wide long-on for a single
Full outside off, swings it away off the inside half of the bat wide of long-on and that's fifty up for Punjab Kings
Length ball steered to deep third for a single
What a shot! That's full on off, Prabhsimran moves across and flicks it gloriously over square leg. That travelled 90 metres!
A swing and a miss! Full and wide, 137kph, Prabhsimran looks to hammer it over the off side but can't get any bat on ball
Full outside off and Dhawan drives it hard in front of point but can't beat the sweeper cover fielder. Only a single
That was a bit of a wild one! Very full and wide of the tramlines. Umpire's arms go up immediately
Starts off with a 132kph length ball around off that Dhawan punches to cover
Length ball tapped between cover and point and Dhawan finishes the powerplay with a single
Dhawan looks to come down the track but Dayal goes for a length ball around middle and leg. Dhawan misses his attempted flick and the ball lobs towards cover off his pad
Peach! Test match length outside off at 137kph, the ball straightens just a bit as Dhawan pokes at it
Tucked to midwicket and Prabhsimran races for a quick single. Dinesh Karthik reacts quick and has a direct hit at the non-striker's end but the batter was in safely
Another full delivery swinging away across Prabhsimran, but he frees his arms and drives it inside out over cover. The connection isn't great but it's enough to get four
Full on off and angled across, Prabhsimran looks to drive but is beaten on the outside edge
Great fielding by Dayal at deep third! Back of length at 140kph, Dhawan uses the pace beautifully to steer it fine of Dayal but he saves two runs for RCB
Driven past a diving mid-off fielder! Alzarri pitches this 144kph delivery up a tad too full and Dhawan meets it with the full face of the bat. Mid-off runs to his left and dives but to no avail
Another length ball close to off stump that Dhawan can only punch to cover
On a length outside off, pushed to cover where Kohli is quick to react
Beautifully played by Dhawan! Joseph pitches it up around off at 143kph but Dhawan just lofts it over cover and gets the boundary
Full outside off and angling in, 141.5kph, driven out to mid-off
On a length on off and going across him, Prabhsimran pushes it to Kohli's left at cover, but he is quick to hurl himself at it and ensure there's no single on offer
Full delivery outside off, Dhawan pushes it towards mid-off and sets off for a run
Full delivery outside off and angled across Prabhsimran, who opens his bat face to guide the ball to deep third
Length ball going across Prabhsimran, who parries it to the off side
Length ball steered behind point to the fielder in the deep
Dhawan leaves another length ball outsde off from Dayal
On a length outside off, Prabhsimran fends
Gentle push down the ground, beats mid-on racing across and the ball goes away for four! Beautiful timing on a full delivery at 141kph angling in from outside off
Back of length delivery outside off jas in, Prabhsimran fends it away

Skied and gone! Great comeback for Siraj. Bairstow swipes at a length ball. The bat turns in his hand as he hits it and it goes up. Kohli settles under it coming in from cover and takes it with no fuss
Short-ish, wide and slashed away! Just a hint of width and that's all he needs to crash it through point
And there goes Bairstow! In the arc and he swings it away aerially wide of mid-on for his first boundary
Bairstow comes down the track but Dayal holds his length back. Ricochets off the pads onto the off side and they get a leg bye. Good start for Dayal
On a length on off, Dhawan taps it in front and gets a quick single
Inswinger this time, honing in on Dhawan's off stump. Dhawan meets it with a push to Kohli at cover
Beats him! Or not. It's fuller outside off, Dhawan plays inside the line as he lets it go by
Another length ball, wider of off this time and Dhawan leaves it alone again
Starts off with a length ball outside off, Dhawan shoulders arms
Pushed full around off, Bairstow defends
Full on a fourth stump line, Bairstow pushes it down the ground to mid-off
Full on leg, clipped away to deep backward square
Full and swinging in on middle, Dhawan flicks it in the gap between square leg and midwicket. the square leg fielder gives chase as Dhawan picks up two more runs
Length ball around middle, Dhawan defends
Full outside off, Dhawan gives it a gentle push wide of mid-off and Maxwell lets it slip through and the ball gets away for the first four of the match

Drilled down the ground, DK's reviving himself and takes RCB to a win in their first home game. Arshdeep went full and just outside off, Karthik got across and blasted it flat over the bowler. Too straight for long-on. Crowd are ecstatic
Wide and full. The angle takes it too far. DK leans and shapes to play but knows he doesn't have to. Gets the wide and the stumps' lights are doing their own dance

DK scoops the game back in RCB's favour. Whataguy! This was premeditated but to perfection. He was going square-on and the ball was into the pitch, angling outside off, he got behind it and launched it behind again. Short fine leg was in again, he outplayed a pacer. Again!
Goes back towards the yorker. Low fully though, at the stumps, worked to long-on

Bumper sits up and DK hooks it over the fine-leg boundary! Slower one, 126ks, landed short, angled in to go over leg stump. Sat up for DK to get inside the line and launch it. Short fine leg was in, just a 59-metre hit. Brings the equation down to 11 off 7
Low fully hits pad, lbw not given. Harshal is interested, no review. 140ks, angling on leg, DK tries to clip behind square, gets opened up. Ball goes offside but nearby
Cannoned over the bowler. Hard length, 136ks, angling in towards fourth. Karthik didn't have to shift his line, got his weight forward and slapped it
Karthik starts backing away before coming back but Harshal, smartly bowls a Test ball to beat him. Three-quarter length on fifth, 140ks, Karthik was late on the attempted steer towards third. Beaten
Angle works against Harshal this time. The full ball goes past the flick and down leg. Good stop by the keeper
It's full but not a yorker. Delivered from wide of the crease, angling towards fourth. Lomror was in the crease, drove it to long-off, along the ground
Low full toss on middle, slipped with power but it's straight at square leg's shin.
Wide and full, outside Lomror's hitting arc. He's on one knee, but the stride is straight and not towards the line, tries to slash it over cover. Misses
Speaker on, full volume! Short this time, around shoulder height, Lomror swivels and pulls. Didn't need to look at it, knew he'd get it over backward square
Slugged over cow corner! Slot ball angling in at off, 136ks, Lomror stays in the crease, twists his ankle inwards and launches it
Pulls the shortish ball to deep square leg
Slower bouncer beats the pull, RCB get a bye though
Full and slow on leg, clipped to the right of Arshdeep at deep fine leg. DK scampers back for a tight second, makes it!
Down leg again. Back-of-length offcutter misses the line, it's helped off the top of the thighs. Four to fine leg
Harpreet Bhatia charges in from backward point as they go for the run, can't pick it up. It rolls back but they settle for one. Length outside off, was defended with an angled bat
Full and on the pads, drifting leg side and it's clipped wide of short fine for four

Slower one hits pad, that looked dead. Given too, Rawat reviews. Offcutter at 108ks, was the turn taking it too far? Impact seems to have been on middle and leg. Rawat was on the front foot and got hit under the knee roll after being beaten on the flick. Dhawan has a word with Curran while Hawk-Eye loads. That might not have been a cutter, almost looks like a back of handed. Chetan, our scorer, says it might be a googly. What does it say now? Clipping leg stump, decision stands.
Full ball is pushed to mid-off

Slashed, taken at wide third! That is field placement at its best! Harpreet was somewhere between deep third and deep-backward point and got a low catch in front. Kohli made room and tried to lift the 135ks full ball, couldn't get the placement right or the power to clear the man. He leans on his bat in disappointment. PBKS ahead now?
Nails the yorker. 137ks, Kohli jams it from fifth stump, deep midwicket has to run to the diagonal right. Didn't have to cover much ground, but Kohli's quick enough to return for two
Goes for a wide bouncer, misses both on line and length. Second bouncer for the over done. Spongy bounce took it above head. Let go
Tries carving it over third, misses and curses in frustration. Was a slower bouncer around neck-height
Slaps it through cover, he's done that with aplomb tonight. Hard-length just outside off in the late 130ks range, he stood still, upright, and let his hands power through
Filthy full toss just over the pad, 138ks, Kohli whips it with ease. No one at long leg and it races along. Kohli didn't have to move
Length on fourth, goes back and guides it to deep third. 137ks
Fullish just outside off, swept hard to deep midwicket
Makes room, gets followed by a 91ks fullish ball that he tries sweeping. Goes off the body towards shorrt fine

Good running, takes two to forward square leg. Deep midwicket hurried, slid before picking up and throwing it in motion from Livingstone, but Kohli was in. Was a length ball on leg that was tucked gently
Dances down and Harpreet goes into the pitch. Whipped on the move, from outside off to long-on

Beaten on the one-knee slog sweep. Hits him around the box in front of off. Close but is the angle taking it too outside off? Was a length ball and Rawat tried to lift on top of the bounce. Hawk-Eye shows it was pitching just outside leg, the umpire smiles while giving it not out
Fuller side of length on fifth, worked to the leg side
Makes room and gets bounced. Nastily. Rabada followed him and Kohli tried to jab it over the slips but could only sniff it
Length around fifth, slapped to deep point
Length around off, defended. Guessing they'll see off Rabada now
Kohli still happy to be aggressive. Dances down and tries to pull the bumper but toes it into the grass around midwicket, he thought of two but slipped at the other end. Might not have been on anyway
Full on fourth, guided to deep third off the front foot. 136ks
Glanced fine, too fine for Harshal in the deep. Was a length ball on the thigh pad, was helped from deep in the crease
Full on leg, 92ks, beats the flick and dribbles closeby
Full on leg, clipped to square leg
Spins back in to find the inside edge. Length ball landed around sixth and Rawat went for the back-foot cover drive.
Length on middle and off, 93ks, punched off the back foot to long-on
Length outside off, slapped to deep point

Maxwell makes room and chops it on! This is why fingerspinners bowl stump to stump in T20s. Maxwell made room to open up the offside but underedged onto ground and back on to middle. 90ks. Like after the last wicket, Harpreet has a thigh-five and spreads his arms wide
Belted straight of mid-off, RCB's 100 is up. The flat-bat has been Kohli's friend tonight, he's charged at pacers to increase its appeal. This was shortish and was powered. Fielder was in
Full ball has been clipped to deep square leg
Bumper just outside off, bounces too high. Let go. 142ks
Wide on a length, tries to muscle it but the bat turns in the hand. Rolls to long-on
Three-quarter length on off, 137ks, guided with an open face, to deep-backward point
Top edges the pull this time, it falls safely at mid-on! Tried to pull the shortish ball but it got big on him.

Pulled, deep square leg is in play but it clears him! Just 65 metres, smaller boundary. Fielder was a few metres in, he went back and tried pulling it in. Got no hand on it. Ball was angled at the body and Kohli didn't roll his wrists on the pull
Another sighter for Maxwell. He clips the full ball on leg to the right of midwicket, who's alert on the ball
Fullish on leg, 91ks, nudged to square leg
Full around off, 94ks, defended towards backward point
Darted into middle, beats Patidar's attempted hoick over midwicket! Length ball, coming in with the angle, was an arm ball. Pace in the late 90ks. Patidar couldn't shift gears after being promoted.
Makes room and tries to sweep the length ball, gets beaten. Got big bounce, beats the keeper
Tries to flick the ball and gets beaten
Test ball to beat bat. 146ks, on the fuller side of length, fourth-stump line. Patidar stays leg side and tried defending, maybe run it through the vacant slip area but ended up tentative and beaten
Length in the channel, defended to backward point. Pace up in the 140ks
Too straight, Patidar tries glancing it fine. It goes wide of the keeper, given leg byes
Slower bouncer just outside off, spongy bounce takes it over head. Let go
Kohli's 100th score of 50+ in T20s. No celebrations, just working on the bat grip. He whipped this off the body, through midwicket
Wide and on the fuller side, Kohli reaches out and slashes it into the deep-third outfield. Gets it wide to pick up two
Kohli wants to take on the returning Rabada, made room and got followed by a full ball. He tried whipping over midwicket, met with thin air
Tries slog sweeping but can't connect. On the fuller side and on the pad, think he missed out
Sits up off a length, lands around off and is cut from fifth stump, to deep point
Flaying the spinner now is Kohli. Wide and full, he got on one knee, reached out and slapped it. Did it land on the cushion. Being checked upstairs. Yes, that's six.
Length on leg, clipped to midwicket

Tossed up, it's mashed down the ground. High-ball, is it far enough? Yes, but by only just. Length legbreak that was spinning away, Patidar oared it against the wave, had to take a chance and it came off
Wide and on the shorter side, Patidar tries slapping it with a flat bat. Over the bowler but not middled, gets it to the outfield
Length just outside off, opens the face and drives to deep-backward point
Wide on a length, tries stirring it behind point. Misses
Heaves it over the midwicket fielder. Into the pitch, not much room to extend the arms fully, but Kohli controlled it well enough
Creamed off the back foot to the right of cover, Livingstone is the sweeper racing across to the right, stops it well. Was a wide ball that was hit with a breezy whoosh of the cross bat
Goes back to a length ball and helps it along with the pull. Stopped at deep square leg
Yorker on leg from wide of the crease, 137ks, clipped to midwicket. Well handled by Patidar, who jammed it and got the back foot out the way
Runs saved by YJB at point this time. Dives to the right and cuts off the travelling ball. Length ball around fifth was cut with power.
Fullish on middle, stays legside of the ball and defends it gently towards cover point
Makes room and tucks the length ball on leg, at 88ks, to square leg
Length on leg, clipped to deep-backward square
Tries to shovel it down leg but gets it off the pad. Still goes into the outfield
Cut to cover off the back foot
Rabada saves three more, this time with a dive to the right. Was a length ball outside off that was steered off the back foot
Full on the pads, 132ks, swings in and beats the attempted whip across the line
Rabada saves three at short third by diving to the left. Was a length ball around off, defended late

Midwicket almost pulls off a stunning one-hander. It was Chahar salmon-diving to the left, got hands on it but could only parry it towards mid-on. It turned into a tight run, no direct hit. Was a length ball around off that Kohli tried clobbering across the line. Bat face turned and it went around knee-height. Distance was the issue
Leathered but Patidar's hit on the non-striker's end. Kohli stayed leg side of the length ball and prioritised power. On the up but he's been happy to take that on today
Length around off, defends with an angled bat. Perhaps too much as it lands just behind and bounces over the stumps
Crisp and pure, through cover it races for four. Full around fifth, Patidar eases it with a check. Went off the absolute middle
Length around off, defended in front

Appeal for caught behind, there's a small chat about whether the was catch. Looked like the umpire raised his finger but it is actually sent upstairs. Jitesh dove to the right and took it low, ball went straight in the gloves. Was a wide 137ks length ball that was around the offside tramline. Green tried heaving it square on the offside but even his reach wasn't enough
Overthrow from short third, direct hit at the striker's stumps and it goes towards the vacant square-leg region. Was a pacy hard-length ball that beat Kohli on the pull and hit the pad
Length outside off, opens the face and taps it towards point
Length on leg, beats the full-faced defence that was attempted
Guided wide of slip! Length around fifth, he waited and used the pace and angle. Bairstow dives in vain, not in reach this time. That went right off the sticker too
Bumper tried for a change. Fifth-stump line around head-height, controlled pull into the ground takes it to midwicket

Whipped over midwicket, Kohli showing clarity in thought. Saw this one straight and fullish, the upper body went down in reflex, the elbows were buckled and the bat swing - down to up - had full control
Full swingling ball goes down leg. Past the flick, keeper dives full-length to stop it
Overpitched, driven firmly but Curran dives to the right at mid-off to cut it off. Four saved
Shot of the day on repeat. This time Kohli dances down to Arshdeep and flays him through extra. He's flying in free skies after that drop. Amazing how he picks it off of hard lengths
Length around off, defended to backward point
Full ball has been clothed to mid-on, Green going too hard at the drive
Full on leg, whipped through midwicket

Skied to mid-on, Rabada gets his former skipper. Full ball at 137ks at the stumps, Faf tried getting under it and launching it down the ground, got it off the bottom edge. The open stance doesn't help as he can't transfer the weight forward. He knew he was gone right away. Easy enough catch for Curran, who is pumped
Appeal for caught behind, nothing on it. Wide ball on a length, Faf's stance has been open with front foot on middle and back foot down leg, he tried slapping it square this time. Misses
Guides the length ball just outside off to deep point
Spectacularly flayed over cover! Danced down the pitch to a hard-length ball, over middle stump, Kohli goes Nataraja mode and creams it with a flat bat
Curves in again but it lands just outside leg. Faf falls over legside while being beaten on the flick
Tad back of length on fourth, 137ks, slapped from the top of the bounce through cover. Good even bounce there
Full on the pads, beats the whip and goes towards square leg. A bit of swing again but started too straight
Down leg, beats the glance. Wide, but Kohli disappointed to not have put it
Tight single to Arshdeep's right at cover. Faf falls forward just after making it but is thankfully okay. Was a length ball around off that was defended
Fullish on off, a bit of inswing, stays leg side and defends in front
Length outside off, let go. Faf wanted to play at it but withdrew the bat
Dances down, gets it on the half-volley and creams it through cover.
Length around off, blocked in front
Down leg and it's helped fine. Three-quarter length just over the pad, glanced with ease.
Kohli walks down to cut off the length, drives it on the up, beats cover to the left. Was a length ball but turned into a fullish one.

YJB has dropped it at first slip! Just above head height, tried to take it with both hands but it burst through the palms. He was standing still but leapt last second. Got done for pace, was standing in front of the keeper too. Early life for Kohli. Was a wide length ball, going away with the angle - close to the tramline, the cover drive on-the-up was attempted.
Thick outside edge first up, not very uppish. Goes to short third. Pitched up around off, Kohli tried driving down the ground, played well in front
